title: Building a Capsule Wardrobe Around Two or Three Tailored Pieces
excerpt: You don't need twenty garments to look put-together every day. You need a handful that actually fit and work together.
author: Lipek Fashion Team
body: Most wardrobes are full of near-misses — clothes that are almost right, worn because they're there rather than because they work. A tailored capsule flips that: fewer pieces, all of them correct.
Start with one blazer or jacket in a neutral tone that pairs with everything you already own. This single piece does more visual work than any five items bought on sale.
Add tailored trousers in a shade that matches your most-worn shoes, and one shirt cut precisely to your torso. From these three pieces alone, most clients build a week of outfits.
Because everything is cut to your measurements from the start, layering pieces sit correctly on top of each other — no bunching at the shoulder, no gaping at the waist under a blazer.
